whole_exchange_context:
A town speaker, actor87, asks whether the party too has come to meet an old man named Mikhail. Lil has not heard of him. A conditional actor6 reaction urgently objects to meeting him and addresses FI. The speaker calls Mikhail locally famous for knowing many things. Lil is interested and actor9 proposes visiting. The town speaker warns that visiting may be unwise if they have women with them, and a second conditional actor6 remark emphatically agrees. Lil is puzzled. Keep the optional warning, not an invented family feud, jealousy, known history or source port. Both actor6 remarks have their own membership-gated containers; the exact source-native conditions require binding. Source age-related familiar addresses do not establish kinship.
Actor9 points Mikhail out. Two female-addressed interlocutors, actors165/166, admire him and ask questions. Their exact source/current role/name consumers must be bound; no exact ages, family relationship or personal names are established by the raw selectors. Mikhail boasts and laughs in an old man's speech style. He identifies an object as pepper fruit, explains that it grows on a tropical tree and becomes a spice when ground, and says it should thrive around Brunei and become a useful trade good. He then realizes it is rabbit droppings, calls it dirty and throws it away after an upset request. Preserve the confident explanation followed by the reversal, the place and tentative prediction. No real pepper item, trade unlock, item award or botanical correction is supplied by this dialogue.
One interlocutor praises his knowledge and asks why he knows so much. He calls himself a genius, boasts that few people know more and says he can even guess her bust size. She calls him lewd; he laughs. This is character speech and a sexual-harassment gag, not narrator endorsement, a consensual relationship, a claim of actual measurement or permission to touch. Familiar おじいちゃん does not mean the women are his granddaughters. Preserve the mild source sexual reference without adding anatomy, explicit actions, measurements, ages or graphic detail.
Actor9 acknowledges that Mikhail is strange but seems knowledgeable. Lil thinks he is too strange and lecherous. Actor9 reassures her that FI will be all right; Lil snaps back at the implication. Preserve the teasing ambiguity without inventing a body-shape insult, gender fact, reason he would not be interested or literal protection guarantee. Lil nevertheless considers his knowledge useful to a group like theirs. Actor9 self-deprecatingly says none of their group is particularly learned and suggests speaking to him. A conditional actor20 aside objects to being included in that judgment. No specific qualifications, roles, ranks or exclusions are added.
Mikhail brusquely asks who they are. Actor9 addresses him by name and asks him to put his extensive knowledge to use for FO and join their companions. Mikhail says he no longer intends to leave this town and rejects an invitation from a man. Actor9 repeats that they need his knowledge. As he hesitates, Mikhail notices Lil, asks her name and hears FI plus FA, followed by her brusque question about why he asks. Keep both exact runtime name substitutions and FO earlier; Japanese name punctuation need not imply a spoken middle name or kinship. He repeats her given name with a familiar suffix, expresses delight and abruptly declares that he will go along. His decision changes because of this interaction, not a new fee, promise, official appointment or revelation of Lil's age.
He calls FI and says he will follow her anywhere. Lil objects to his approaching without permission. Actor9 hurriedly withdraws the invitation and says he need not join after all. Mikhail refuses to reconsider, insists on coming and promises to put his knowledge to use. Actor9 reluctantly allows him aboard and starts a condition about his treatment of FI, but interrupts himself as Mikhail acts. Preserve that unfinished condition rather than inventing a completed set of rules. Mikhail calls FI again with a printed touching cue. Lil angrily challenges where he is touching and calls him a lecherous old man. He gives a comic yelp; actor9 sighs. The source does not identify a touched body part or a particular blow in these words. Preserve the unwanted-touch cue, protest and reaction without inventing a kiss, romance, graphic groping detail or specific physical punishment; source presentation/sound controls require their own binding.
One later A000 and presentation/resource commands precede three FE system panels. The panels explain that Mikhail, described as 博物博士, is not a navigator and cannot be assigned on deck; having him enables detailed item information; press X while item information is displayed. Bind the natural-history role, navigator/Deck and Item Info/X terms to original consumers and reviewed current UI rather than inventing an academic degree, rank, cabin or attribute bonus. Keep the exact condition and input timing; no button action is required during ordinary speech. Mikhail finally admits he cannot do shipboard work but asks to be treated well and called when they want to know about items. Two consecutive declared end words follow. records.whole_exchange_context:
A town speaker, actor87, asks whether the party too has come to meet an old man named Mikhail. Lil has not heard of him. A conditional actor6 reaction urgently objects to meeting him and addresses FI. The speaker calls Mikhail locally famous for knowing many things. Lil is interested and actor9 proposes visiting. The town speaker warns that visiting may be unwise if they have women with them, and a second conditional actor6 remark emphatically agrees. Lil is puzzled. Keep the optional warning, not an invented family feud, jealousy, known history or source port. Both actor6 remarks have their own membership-gated containers; the exact source-native conditions require binding. Source age-related familiar addresses do not establish kinship.
Actor9 points Mikhail out. Two female-addressed interlocutors, actors165/166, admire him and ask questions. Their exact source/current role/name consumers must be bound; no exact ages, family relationship or personal names are established by the raw selectors. Mikhail boasts and laughs in an old man's speech style. He identifies an object as pepper fruit, explains that it grows on a tropical tree and becomes a spice when ground, and says it should thrive around Brunei and become a useful trade good. He then realizes it is rabbit droppings, calls it dirty and throws it away after an upset request. Preserve the confident explanation followed by the reversal, the place and tentative prediction. No real pepper item, trade unlock, item award or botanical correction is supplied by this dialogue.
One interlocutor praises his knowledge and asks why he knows so much. He calls himself a genius, boasts that few people know more and says he can even guess her bust size. She calls him lewd; he laughs. This is character speech and a sexual-harassment gag, not narrator endorsement, a consensual relationship, a claim of actual measurement or permission to touch. Familiar おじいちゃん does not mean the women are his granddaughters. Preserve the mild source sexual reference without adding anatomy, explicit actions, measurements, ages or graphic detail.
Actor9 acknowledges that Mikhail is strange but seems knowledgeable. Lil thinks he is too strange and lecherous. Actor9 reassures her that FI will be all right; Lil snaps back at the implication. Preserve the teasing ambiguity without inventing a body-shape insult, gender fact, reason he would not be interested or literal protection guarantee. Lil nevertheless considers his knowledge useful to a group like theirs. Actor9 self-deprecatingly says none of their group is particularly learned and suggests speaking to him. A conditional actor20 aside objects to being included in that judgment. No specific qualifications, roles, ranks or exclusions are added.
Mikhail brusquely asks who they are. Actor9 addresses him by name and asks him to put his extensive knowledge to use for FO and join their companions. Mikhail says he no longer intends to leave this town and rejects an invitation from a man. Actor9 repeats that they need his knowledge. As he hesitates, Mikhail notices Lil, asks her name and hears FI plus FA, followed by her brusque question about why he asks. Keep both exact runtime name substitutions and FO earlier; Japanese name punctuation need not imply a spoken middle name or kinship. He repeats her given name with a familiar suffix, expresses delight and abruptly declares that he will go along. His decision changes because of this interaction, not a new fee, promise, official appointment or revelation of Lil's age.
He calls FI and says he will follow her anywhere. Lil objects to his approaching without permission. Actor9 hurriedly withdraws the invitation and says he need not join after all. Mikhail refuses to reconsider, insists on coming and promises to put his knowledge to use. Actor9 reluctantly allows him aboard and starts a condition about his treatment of FI, but interrupts himself as Mikhail acts. Preserve that unfinished condition rather than inventing a completed set of rules. Mikhail calls FI again with a printed touching cue. Lil angrily challenges where he is touching and calls him a lecherous old man. He gives a comic yelp; actor9 sighs. The source does not identify a touched body part or a particular blow in these words. Preserve the unwanted-touch cue, protest and reaction without inventing a kiss, romance, graphic groping detail or specific physical punishment; source presentation/sound controls require their own binding.
One later A000 and presentation/resource commands precede three FE system panels. The panels explain that Mikhail, described as 博物博士, is not a navigator and cannot be assigned on deck; having him enables detailed item information; press X while item information is displayed. Bind the natural-history role, navigator/Deck and Item Info/X terms to original consumers and reviewed current UI rather than inventing an academic degree, rank, cabin or attribute bonus. Keep the exact condition and input timing; no button action is required during ordinary speech. Mikhail finally admits he cannot do shipboard work but asks to be treated well and called when they want to know about items. Two consecutive declared end words follow. Spoken consent or printed help must not move the original runtime effect. Do not infer earned recruitment, item acquisition, a source port, full eligibility or state changes from offline probes.

records.whole_exchange_context:
A town speaker, actor87, asks whether the party too has come to meet an old man named Mikhail. Lil has not heard of him. A conditional actor6 reaction urgently objects to meeting him and addresses FI. The speaker calls Mikhail locally famous for knowing many things. Lil is interested and actor9 proposes visiting. The town speaker warns that visiting may be unwise if they have women with them, and a second conditional actor6 remark emphatically agrees. Lil is puzzled. Keep the optional warning, not an invented family feud, jealousy, known history or source port. Both actor6 remarks have their own membership-gated containers; the exact source-native conditions require binding. Source age-related familiar addresses do not establish kinship.
Actor9 points Mikhail out. Two female-addressed interlocutors, actors165/166, admire him and ask questions. Their exact source/current role/name consumers must be bound; no exact ages, family relationship or personal names are established by the raw selectors. Mikhail boasts and laughs in an old man's speech style. He identifies an object as pepper fruit, explains that it grows on a tropical tree and becomes a spice when ground, and says it should thrive around Brunei and become a useful trade good. He then realizes it is rabbit droppings, calls it dirty and throws it away after an upset request. Preserve the confident explanation followed by the reversal, the place and tentative prediction. No real pepper item, trade unlock, item award or botanical correction is supplied by this dialogue.
One interlocutor praises his knowledge and asks why he knows so much. He calls himself a genius, boasts that few people know more and says he can even guess her bust size. She calls him lewd; he laughs. This is character speech and a sexual-harassment gag, not narrator endorsement, a consensual relationship, a claim of actual measurement or permission to touch. Familiar おじいちゃん does not mean the women are his granddaughters. Preserve the mild source sexual reference without adding anatomy, explicit actions, measurements, ages or graphic detail.
Actor9 acknowledges that Mikhail is strange but seems knowledgeable. Lil thinks he is too strange and lecherous. Actor9 reassures her that FI will be all right; Lil snaps back at the implication. Preserve the teasing ambiguity without inventing a body-shape insult, gender fact, reason he would not be interested or literal protection guarantee. Lil nevertheless considers his knowledge useful to a group like theirs. Actor9 self-deprecatingly says none of their group is particularly learned and suggests speaking to him. A conditional actor20 aside objects to being included in that judgment. No specific qualifications, roles, ranks or exclusions are added.
Mikhail brusquely asks who they are. Actor9 addresses him by name and asks him to put his extensive knowledge to use for FO and join their companions. Mikhail says he no longer intends to leave this town and rejects an invitation from a man. Actor9 repeats that they need his knowledge. As he hesitates, Mikhail notices Lil, asks her name and hears FI plus FA, followed by her brusque question about why he asks. Keep both exact runtime name substitutions and FO earlier; Japanese name punctuation need not imply a spoken middle name or kinship. He repeats her given name with a familiar suffix, expresses delight and abruptly declares that he will go along. His decision changes because of this interaction, not a new fee, promise, official appointment or revelation of Lil's age.
He calls FI and says he will follow her anywhere. Lil objects to his approaching without permission. Actor9 hurriedly withdraws the invitation and says he need not join after all. Mikhail refuses to reconsider, insists on coming and promises to put his knowledge to use. Actor9 reluctantly allows him aboard and starts a condition about his treatment of FI, but interrupts himself as Mikhail acts. Preserve that unfinished condition rather than inventing a completed set of rules. Mikhail calls FI again with a printed touching cue. Lil angrily challenges where he is touching and calls him a lecherous old man. He gives a comic yelp; actor9 sighs. The source does not identify a touched body part or a particular blow in these words. Preserve the unwanted-touch cue, protest and reaction without inventing a kiss, romance, graphic groping detail or specific physical punishment; source presentation/sound controls require their own binding.
One later A000 and presentation/resource commands precede three FE system panels. The panels explain that Mikhail, described as 博物博士, is not a navigator and cannot be assigned on deck; having him enables detailed item information; press X while item information is displayed. Bind the natural-history role, navigator/Deck and Item Info/X terms to original consumers and reviewed current UI rather than inventing an academic degree, rank, cabin or attribute bonus. Keep the exact condition and input timing; no button action is required during ordinary speech. Mikhail finally admits he cannot do shipboard work but asks to be treated well and called when they want to know about items. Two consecutive declared end words follow. records.whole_exchange_context:
A town speaker, actor87, asks whether the party too has come to meet an old man named Mikhail. Lil has not heard of him. A conditional actor6 reaction urgently objects to meeting him and addresses FI. The speaker calls Mikhail locally famous for knowing many things. Lil is interested and actor9 proposes visiting. The town speaker warns that visiting may be unwise if they have women with them, and a second conditional actor6 remark emphatically agrees. Lil is puzzled. Keep the optional warning, not an invented family feud, jealousy, known history or source port. Both actor6 remarks have their own membership-gated containers; the exact source-native conditions require binding. Source age-related familiar addresses do not establish kinship.
Actor9 points Mikhail out. Two female-addressed interlocutors, actors165/166, admire him and ask questions. Their exact source/current role/name consumers must be bound; no exact ages, family relationship or personal names are established by the raw selectors. Mikhail boasts and laughs in an old man's speech style. He identifies an object as pepper fruit, explains that it grows on a tropical tree and becomes a spice when ground, and says it should thrive around Brunei and become a useful trade good. He then realizes it is rabbit droppings, calls it dirty and throws it away after an upset request. Preserve the confident explanation followed by the reversal, the place and tentative prediction. No real pepper item, trade unlock, item award or botanical correction is supplied by this dialogue.
One interlocutor praises his knowledge and asks why he knows so much. He calls himself a genius, boasts that few people know more and says he can even guess her bust size. She calls him lewd; he laughs. This is character speech and a sexual-harassment gag, not narrator endorsement, a consensual relationship, a claim of actual measurement or permission to touch. Familiar おじいちゃん does not mean the women are his granddaughters. Preserve the mild source sexual reference without adding anatomy, explicit actions, measurements, ages or graphic detail.
Actor9 acknowledges that Mikhail is strange but seems knowledgeable. Lil thinks he is too strange and lecherous. Actor9 reassures her that FI will be all right; Lil snaps back at the implication. Preserve the teasing ambiguity without inventing a body-shape insult, gender fact, reason he would not be interested or literal protection guarantee. Lil nevertheless considers his knowledge useful to a group like theirs. Actor9 self-deprecatingly says none of their group is particularly learned and suggests speaking to him. A conditional actor20 aside objects to being included in that judgment. No specific qualifications, roles, ranks or exclusions are added.
Mikhail brusquely asks who they are. Actor9 addresses him by name and asks him to put his extensive knowledge to use for FO and join their companions. Mikhail says he no longer intends to leave this town and rejects an invitation from a man. Actor9 repeats that they need his knowledge. As he hesitates, Mikhail notices Lil, asks her name and hears FI plus FA, followed by her brusque question about why he asks. Keep both exact runtime name substitutions and FO earlier; Japanese name punctuation need not imply a spoken middle name or kinship. He repeats her given name with a familiar suffix, expresses delight and abruptly declares that he will go along. His decision changes because of this interaction, not a new fee, promise, official appointment or revelation of Lil's age.
He calls FI and says he will follow her anywhere. Lil objects to his approaching without permission. Actor9 hurriedly withdraws the invitation and says he need not join after all. Mikhail refuses to reconsider, insists on coming and promises to put his knowledge to use. Actor9 reluctantly allows him aboard and starts a condition about his treatment of FI, but interrupts himself as Mikhail acts. Preserve that unfinished condition rather than inventing a completed set of rules. Mikhail calls FI again with a printed touching cue. Lil angrily challenges where he is touching and calls him a lecherous old man. He gives a comic yelp; actor9 sighs. The source does not identify a touched body part or a particular blow in these words. Preserve the unwanted-touch cue, protest and reaction without inventing a kiss, romance, graphic groping detail or specific physical punishment; source presentation/sound controls require their own binding.
One later A000 and presentation/resource commands precede three FE system panels. The panels explain that Mikhail, described as 博物博士, is not a navigator and cannot be assigned on deck; having him enables detailed item information; press X while item information is displayed. Bind the natural-history role, navigator/Deck and Item Info/X terms to original consumers and reviewed current UI rather than inventing an academic degree, rank, cabin or attribute bonus. Keep the exact condition and input timing; no button action is required during ordinary speech. Mikhail finally admits he cannot do shipboard work but asks to be treated well and called when they want to know about items. Two consecutive declared end words follow. Spoken consent or printed help must not move the original runtime effect. Do not infer earned recruitment, item acquisition, a source port, full eligibility or state changes from offline probes.

A town speaker, actor87, asks whether the party too has come to meet an old man named Mikhail. Lil has not heard of him. A conditional actor6 reaction urgently objects to meeting him and addresses FI. The speaker calls Mikhail locally famous for knowing many things. Lil is interested and actor9 proposes visiting. The town speaker warns that visiting may be unwise if they have women with them, and a second conditional actor6 remark emphatically agrees. Lil is puzzled. Keep the optional warning, not an invented family feud, jealousy, known history or source port. Both actor6 remarks have their own membership-gated containers; the exact source-native conditions require binding. Source age-related familiar addresses do not establish kinship.
Actor9 points Mikhail out. Two female-addressed interlocutors, actors165/166, admire him and ask questions. Their exact source/current role/name consumers must be bound; no exact ages, family relationship or personal names are established by the raw selectors. Mikhail boasts and laughs in an old man's speech style. He identifies an object as pepper fruit, explains that it grows on a tropical tree and becomes a spice when ground, and says it should thrive around Brunei and become a useful trade good. He then realizes it is rabbit droppings, calls it dirty and throws it away after an upset request. Preserve the confident explanation followed by the reversal, the place and tentative prediction. No real pepper item, trade unlock, item award or botanical correction is supplied by this dialogue.
One interlocutor praises his knowledge and asks why he knows so much. He calls himself a genius, boasts that few people know more and says he can even guess her bust size. She calls him lewd; he laughs. This is character speech and a sexual-harassment gag, not narrator endorsement, a consensual relationship, a claim of actual measurement or permission to touch. Familiar おじいちゃん does not mean the women are his granddaughters. Preserve the mild source sexual reference without adding anatomy, explicit actions, measurements, ages or graphic detail.
Actor9 acknowledges that Mikhail is strange but seems knowledgeable. Lil thinks he is too strange and lecherous. Actor9 reassures her that FI will be all right; Lil snaps back at the implication. Preserve the teasing ambiguity without inventing a body-shape insult, gender fact, reason he would not be interested or literal protection guarantee. Lil nevertheless considers his knowledge useful to a group like theirs. Actor9 self-deprecatingly says none of their group is particularly learned and suggests speaking to him. A conditional actor20 aside objects to being included in that judgment. No specific qualifications, roles, ranks or exclusions are added.
Mikhail brusquely asks who they are. Actor9 addresses him by name and asks him to put his extensive knowledge to use for FO and join their companions. Mikhail says he no longer intends to leave this town and rejects an invitation from a man. Actor9 repeats that they need his knowledge. As he hesitates, Mikhail notices Lil, asks her name and hears FI plus FA, followed by her brusque question about why he asks. Keep both exact runtime name substitutions and FO earlier; Japanese name punctuation need not imply a spoken middle name or kinship. He repeats her given name with a familiar suffix, expresses delight and abruptly declares that he will go along. His decision changes because of this interaction, not a new fee, promise, official appointment or revelation of Lil's age.
He calls FI and says he will follow her anywhere. Lil objects to his approaching without permission. Actor9 hurriedly withdraws the invitation and says he need not join after all. Mikhail refuses to reconsider, insists on coming and promises to put his knowledge to use. Actor9 reluctantly allows him aboard and starts a condition about his treatment of FI, but interrupts himself as Mikhail acts. Preserve that unfinished condition rather than inventing a completed set of rules. Mikhail calls FI again with a printed touching cue. Lil angrily challenges where he is touching and calls him a lecherous old man. He gives a comic yelp; actor9 sighs. The source does not identify a touched body part or a particular blow in these words. Preserve the unwanted-touch cue, protest and reaction without inventing a kiss, romance, graphic groping detail or specific physical punishment; source presentation/sound controls require their own binding.
One later A000 and presentation/resource commands precede three FE system panels. The panels explain that Mikhail, described as 博物博士, is not a navigator and cannot be assigned on deck; having him enables detailed item information; press X while item information is displayed. Bind the natural-history role, navigator/Deck and Item Info/X terms to original consumers and reviewed current UI rather than inventing an academic degree, rank, cabin or attribute bonus. Keep the exact condition and input timing; no button action is required during ordinary speech. Mikhail finally admits he cannot do shipboard work but asks to be treated well and called when they want to know about items. Two consecutive declared end words follow. Spoken consent or printed help must not move the original runtime effect. Do not infer earned recruitment, item acquisition, a source port, full eligibility or state changes from offline probes.
